contourHttpProxy.description: The timeout policy configuration for httpproxy.

idleTimeout.description: Timeout for how long the proxy should wait while there is no activity during single request/response (for HTTP/1.1) or stream (for HTTP/2).

timeout.description: Timeout for receiving a response from the server after processing a request from client.

replicas.description: The replicas for the core component.

secret.description: Secret is used when core server communicates with other components.

xsrfKey.description: The XSRF key. Must be a string of 32 chars.

createNetworkPolicy.description: Create a networkpolicy in Harbor's namespace when it's true.  This is required to be true for Harbor Supervisor Service

coreDatabase.description: The db name for external database

password.description: The initial password of the internal postgres database.

type.description: The type of postgres dabasbase, either internal as default , or external

enableContourHttpProxy.description: Use contour http proxy to expose Harbor's endpoints when it's true.

enableNginxLoadBalancer.description: Use nginx and LoadBalancer to expose Harbor's endpoints when it's true.

harborAdminPassword.description: The initial password of Harbor admin.

hostname.description: The FQDN for accessing Harbor admin UI and Registry service.

ingress.description: The ingress related configurations, which are effective only when "enableNginxLoadBalancer" and "enableContourHttpProxy" are both set to false.

className.description: The ingress class name to be used.

registryHttpClientTimeout.description: The request timeout for registry http client

replicas.description: The replicas for the jobservice component.

secret.description: Secret is used when job service communicates with other components.

logLevel.description: The log level of core, exporter, jobservice, registry.

metrics.description: The metrics used by core, registry and exporter

enabled.description: Enable the metrics when it's true

ipFamilies.description: The array of network ipFamilies. Default [] is equivalent to have both ["IPv4","IPv6"]. Or you can choose one of ["IPv4"] or ["IPv6"]

persistence.description:
The persistence is always enabled and a default StorageClass
is needed in the k8s cluster to provision volumes dynamically.
Specify another StorageClass in the "storageClass" or set "existingClaim"
if you have already existing persistent volumes to use

For storing images and charts, you can also use "azure", "gcs", "s3",
"swift" or "oss". Set it in the "imageChartStorage" section

imageChartStorage.description:
Define which storage backend is used for registry and chartmuseum to store
images and charts. Refer to
https://github.com/docker/distribution/blob/master/docs/configuration.md#storage
for the detail.

disableredirect.description:
Specify whether to disable `redirect` for images and chart storage, for
backends which not supported it (such as using minio for `s3` storage type), please disable
it. To disable redirects, simply set `disableredirect` to `true` instead.
Refer to
https://github.com/docker/distribution/blob/master/docs/configuration.md#redirect
for the detail.

encodedkey.description: The base64 encoded json file which contains the key

chunksize.description: Chunk size for the oss, eg 10M.

internal.description: Use the internal endpoint when it's true.

multipartcopychunksize.description: multi part copy chunk size of s3.

multipartcopymaxconcurrency.description: multi part copy max concurrency of s3.

multipartcopythresholdsize.description: multi part copy threshold size of s3.

regionendpoint.description: Region endpoint of s3, eg http://myobjects.local

v4auth.description: Use v4auth for s3 when it's true.

endpointtype.description: Endpoint type of swift, eg public.

insecureskipverify.description: Ignore the cert verify when it's true.

tempurlcontainerkey.description: Use temp url container key of swift when it's true.

type.description:
Specify the type of storage: "filesystem", "azure", "gcs", "s3", "swift",
"oss" and fill the information needed in the corresponding section. The type
must be "filesystem" if you want to use persistent volumes for registry
and chartmuseum

secret.description: Secret is used to secure the upload state from client and registry storage backend.

resources.description: The resource requests and limits for Harbor namespace and containers.

containers.description: The resource requests and limits for Harbor containers.

cpuLimit.description: The CPU Limit for this container.

cpuRequest.description: The CPU request for this container.

memoryLimit.description: The memory limit for this container.

memoryRequest.description: The memory request for this container.

name.description: the name of the container the resource setting should be applied to

namespaceLimitRange.description: the resource Limit Range settings for the namespace where Harbor is installed.

defaultCPURequest.description: The default CPU request for the namespace.

defaultMemoryLimit.description: The default memory limit for the namespace.

defaultMemoryRequest.description: The default memory request for the namespace.

secretKey.description: The secret key used for encryption. Must be a string of 16 chars.

tlsCertificate.description: The tls certificate for the harbor FQDN.

signingSettings.description: The signing settings for the TLS certificate.

additionalDnsNames.description: The DNS names, in addition to hostname in values.yaml, to be included in the TLS certificate SAN.

caIssuer.description: The CA issuer settings to sign the TLS certificate.

ca.crt.description: The CA certificate to sign the TLS certificate.

ca.key.description: The CA private key to sign the TLS certificate.

ipAddresses.description: The IP addresses to be included in the TLS certificate SAN.

tls.crt.description: The certificate. Note that tls.crt is a key and not nested.

tls.key.description: The private key. Note that tls.key is a key and not nested.

tlsSecretLabels.description: the labels you want to add for the harbor-tls secret generated by the tlsCertificate

tlsCertificateSecretName.description: The name of the secret if you want to use your own TLS certificate for harbor FQDN, which contains keys named "tls.crt" and "tls.key".

attributes.description: The attributes is a key value dict contains user defined attributes used to initialize trace provider.

jaeger.description: Jaeger provider for Harbor tracing, it support two modes - collector mode & agent mode.

agent_host.description: The agent_host of jaeger in agent mode.

agent_port.description: The agent_port of jaeger in agent mode.

password.description: The password of jaeger in collector mode.

username.description: The username of jaeger in collector mode.

namespace.description: The namespace used to differentiate different harbor services.

compression.description: Whether to set compression when enabling tracing with Otel.

insecure.description: Whether to connect the collector insecurely.

timeout.description: The max waiting time for the backend to process each spans batch, in seconds.

url_path.description: The url path of tracing with Otel.

provider.description: The provider type of tracing, jaeger or otel.

sample_rate.description: Set sample_rate to 1 if you wanna sampling 100% of trace data; set 0.5 if you wanna sampling 50% of trace data, and so forth.

dbRepository.description: Repository for vulnerability database. You could override it to use a custom or mirrored repository

gitHubToken.description: the GitHub access token to download Trivy DB.

insecure.description: The flag to skip verifying registry certificate. e.g. It would skips verifying the self-hosted registry's certificate for the vulnerability database repository when insecure is set to true.

javaDBRepository.description: Repository for Java vulnerability database. You could override it to use a custom or mirrored repository

offlineScan.description: The offlineScan option prevents Trivy from sending API requests to identify dependencies.

replicas.description: The replicas for the trivy component.

skipJavaDBUpdate.description: The flag to disable Trivy Java DB downloads from remote repository.

skipUpdate.description: The flag to disable Trivy DB downloads from remote repository.

timeout.description: The timeout set for trivy scanner, it should be a number followed by a letter like "h", "m", "s", or "ms", i.e. 1h, 5m, 60s, 1000ms.

tmpdir.description: If /tmp doesn't work for you, you can change it by setting this environment variable. Normally would be /home/scanner

vmciRelayProxy.description: The VMCI relay proxy related configuration, which is used for helping harbor-core access the service in management network.

enabled.description: Deploy the VMCI relay proxy as a sidecar when it's set to true.

managementServices.description: Management services configuration for the vmci relay proxy.

localPort.description: The local port which will be mapped to the management service port.

protocol.description: The protocol the vmci relay proxy to be used to access the management service.  Default value is "tcp"

serviceName.description: The name of the management service which the vmci relay proxy will connect to

servicePortName.description: The name of the management service port which the vmci relay proxy will connect to
